bodyHtml:
Will a bigger pressure tank increase water pressure? Aquasky Pressure tank

Install a bigger pressure tank does not increase the water pressure. The large pressure tank can store more water inside the system and the pump running frequency cycle can also reduce the same amount of water usage in the same period of time.

The large volume pressure tank is always better than the small volume pressure tank in the same system. However, the cost of the system is higher, so an accurate calculation of water volume and pressure is a very important point to have a high-cost efficient system.

The pressure tank storage water volume has to be equal to the pump flow rate per min which means that the pressure tank has to support water usage for a min then the pump starts.

If you have any questions about the calculation, please feel free to contact us.
